package.description: FindLinks reports the file index and any hard links (alternate file paths on the same volume) that exist for the specified file.

en-US.description: FindLinks reports the file index and any hard links (alternate file paths on the same volume) that exist for the specified file.
en-US.longDescription:
FindLinks reports the file index and any hard links (alternate file paths on the same volume) that exist for the specified file. A file's data remains allocated so long as at it has at least one file name referencing it.

Usage: findlinks <filename>
en-US.name: FindLinks
